headline: Volkswagen vehicles made in China are the brand's next big step: they will export more than 300,000 cars a year worldwide
summary: Volkswagen plans to raise output at its Chinese plants for sale in other markets, with Mexico among the first destinations. The company would export more than 300,000 vehicles a year.
why: Volkswagen is a German carmaker with major operations in China, one of the largest auto markets. Shifts in its export mix affect global auto supply and competition.

impacts.name: Volkswagen
impacts.why: The carmaker plans to expand China-built vehicle exports, which changes its production and sales footprint.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

original_headline: Los Volkswagen hechos en China son el siguiente gran paso de la marca: exportarán más de 300,000 autos al año a todo el mundo
